title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
summary: In the summer of 1922, Nick Carraway rents a house next to a mysterious millionaire on Long Island who throws lavish parties. He learns Gatsby's whole fortune is aimed at winning back a woman he loved years ago.
readIf: you want a short, beautifully written novel about longing, money and illusion.
skipIf: you need likeable characters, since almost everyone here is shallow or careless.

pairings.reason: Another story told by an outsider drawn into a glamorous circle that ends badly.
A modern, easier read about charismatic people, excess and what it costs.
A quiet, restrained novel about regret and a life built around an idea that doesn't hold.
